spoken_script: ARIA Bans Wholly AI-Generated Songs from Australian Music Charts. The Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA) has updated its Charts Code of Practice to exclude songs that are wholly or primarily generated by AI. To qualify for charts, tracks must now be substantially human-made, including human-written compositions and human-performed lead vocals or instruments. Why it matters: This policy establishes a clear boundary between human-led artistry and AI-assisted content in a major commercial market, potentially influencing how other global music bodies define authenticity.
